items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: I was playing the trombone at an armature on trumpet. And had old man, George Moret, on trumpet.

ctx.x: Beverly Garden. That's Beverly Garden. So we had mean old man, Kimball and all of us. Papa Celestine, he went with Rizzley too. And we left Hampton Benson, I originally being a trauma player at South. And T.O., he quit P-Rone, he went on over there with us too. So we stuck out there and- You played drums then? He stuck out there a long time, making good money. So well, the boys got to say they want to go back to the red light. Went on back to the red light and played at King Holler.
